subject: English Home Language

show.line: Let's write w and z. w goes down, up, down, up. z zigzags like a bee!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says w, as in worm.
Trace w with your finger. Down, up, down, up.
Tap the letter that says z, as in zebra.
Trace z with your finger. Across, slide down, across.
Point to z. What sound does it make?

hints: w has two points at the bottom. z zigzags.
Start at the top. Go down first.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write w for worm.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Down, up. Look, I wrote w!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is v. w goes down and up two times.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Down, up, down, up. That is w!

parent_line: Can recognise the letters w and z, say their sounds and trace them.
